name: Großheide (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, yellow and black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Großheide (a crossed spade and plough, a wheel, an acorn and stars on black).
history: The acorn symbolises the Berumerfehn forest planted after the cultivation of the moor, and the plough the agricultural character.

features.role: Großheide arms — spade, plough, wheel and acorn on black
